node.title: N=256 square-mass-16 sparse-L1 variance exclusion
node.statement: For profile (3,4,0), put E=V/2=sum_d A_d^2 and L=sum_d |A_d| over the positive-half negacyclic autocorrelation. An exact relaxed minimum-energy slack recurrence gives the required L ceilings for E=39,...,52. Eight optimized quadratic row certificates, four nested-layer third-moment/cubic-Hermite endpoint certificates, and nine mean-tangent logarithmic majorants exclude every even variance 78<=V<=134 by putting the norm below 2^250. Every unresolved vector in this profile has positive even V<=76.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-27: uses profile-specific chord cancellation, exact moment layering, and logarithmic majorants to remove twenty-nine variance values from profile (3,4,0). The positive even V<=76 residual remains open; the tested cubic route reaches its boundary at V=76.
